fact: The 2026 GEF-IFAD implementation report says the ACORN agroforestry carbon project for cocoa and coffee smallholders is held back by challenges in monitoring and quantifying biomass through remote sensing in dense vegetation, and plans georeferenced registration of about 20,000 farmers.
title: Project Implementation Report, FY 2026 3rd PIR: Improving biodiversity mainstreaming in the agro-forestry and fishery sectors in São Tomé and Príncipe
